Long-Term Durability with Premium Components
Built with 100% high-quality Japanese 105°C electrolytic capacitors, the unit ensures long-term stability and durability, even under high
temperatures and continuous heavy loads.
Next-Gen Ready Power
Toughpower TF3 1650W delivers reliable, high-efficiency output with Intel ATX 3.1 and PCIe Gen 5.1 (12V-2x6) support. Its robust +12V rail and
advanced DC-DC design ensure next-gen stability and precise power delivery.
Full Modular Layout with Optimized Airflow
Features a fully modular design with low-profile etched black cables for easy installation, better airflow, and a cleaner build.
Built for Intel ATX 3.1 Standard
The Toughpower TF3 1650W Titanium fully complies with Intel ATX 3.1 specifications, supporting Intel C6/C7 low power states and ErP readiness
for enhanced energy efficiency. It delivers reliable 1650W continuous power at 50°C, meeting strict power timing standards to ensure system
stability and compatibility with modern PC builds.

Thermaltake Customized Cooling Fan
The Toughpower TF3 1650W features the Thermaltake customized cooling fan, it is designed with specially tuned fan blades to push air further.
Industry-Grade Safety Protections
Built-in protections including Over Current Protection (OCP), Over Voltage Protection (OVP), Under Voltage Protection (UVP), Over Power
Protection (OPP), Over Temperature Protection (OTP), and Short Circuit Protection (SCP) safeguard your system against electrical faults,
providing peace of mind and reliable operation.

Unlock Peak Overclocking Performance
The OCM switch gives you the power to optimize your system's performance with ease. By default, the power supply operates in Multi-Rail mode
with Over Current Protection (OCP) to ensure maximum safety for your components. For overclocking enthusiasts, a simple press of the OCM
switch transitions the power supply to Single 12V rail mode, unleashing enhanced power delivery when you need it most.
80 PLUS Titanium Efficiency
Certified for 80 PLUS Titanium with up to 94% efficiency, this unit delivers 1650W continuous output at 50°C. It ensures reduced power loss
and optimized energy use, ideal for high-performance and energy-conscious builds.
Space-Saving Etched Cable Design
Low-profile etched black cables simplify routing, reduce clutter, and enhance airflow. The fully modular layout and Zero Cable Platform allow
for a cleaner, more efficient system build.
